title: Frontend: Render dataset submissions with status badges & admin actions
acceptance_criteria: Below topic replies, a 'Dataset Submissions' section renders when topic.has_dataset_submit is true
Each submission shows: title, content preview, url link (if present), file download (if present), status badge, submitted by username, relative timestamp
Status badges: '🟡 Pending', '🟢 Approved', '🔴 Rejected' with distinct colors
Admin users see Approve/Reject buttons on each submission (calls updateDatasetSubmission)
Approved submissions get a subtle green left-border; rejected get red with strikethrough
Empty state: 'No dataset submissions yet. Be the first!' when array is empty
Real-time updates: new submissions appear without page refresh (Supabase realtime subscription)
